summary: Tested Audio Studio fixes: horizontal scroll, UI cleanup (no Generate Voice/Export buttons), and data persistence with versioning. All requested features working correctly.

horizontal_scroll.details: Timeline scrolls horizontally (0px -> 500px verified) while track controls (Voice Track 1, Background, Sound Effects) remain fixed on left side. Timeline shows different time markers after scroll (00:10, 00:20, 00:30, 00:40 vs 00:00, 00:10, 00:20, 00:30).

generate_voice_button_removed.details: Generate Voice button is NOT present in Audio Studio toolbar. Verified via page.query_selector('button:has-text("Generate Voice")') returning null.

export_button_removed.details: Export button is NOT present in Audio Studio toolbar. Verified via page.query_selector('button:has-text("Export")') returning null.

toolbar_buttons_present.details: Correct buttons present: Upload Audio (data-testid='upload-audio-button'), Add Track (data-testid='add-track-button'), Save (data-testid='save-project-button').

dirty_state_indicator.details: Save button shows 'Save*' when there are unsaved changes. After dragging clip, button text changed from 'Save' to 'Save*'. Also shows 'Unsaved' label next to toolbar.

version_increment_on_save.details: Version incremented from v0 to v1 after clicking Save. Console shows '[Project] Saving v1 with 4 clips' and '[Project] Saved successfully v1'. Toast message: 'Project saved v1 (4 clips)'.

version_display.details: Version displayed correctly as 'v1 • 10:25:46 AM' next to Save button after save.

data_persistence_after_refresh.details: After page refresh, project loaded with v1 and clip at correct position. Console confirms: '[Project] Server version: 1', '[Project] Loaded clip multi-clip-1: track=voice-1, start=1s'.

clip_drag_position_persistence.details: First Clip was dragged to ~1 second position, saved, and after refresh loaded at exactly 1 second (50px at 50px/sec). Position persisted correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All horizontal scroll, UI cleanup, and data persistence features working correctly

seed_data_creation: Used existing project with 4 clips. First Clip was dragged to 1 second position and saved at v1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audio Studio v1 state: 4 clips on Voice Track 1 (multi-clip-1 at 1s, multi-clip-2 at 5s, generated clips at 10s and 12.56s). Horizontal scroll working - track controls fixed on left (192px width via TIMELINE_PADDING), timeline scrollable via timelineViewportRef with overflow-x-auto. Version tracking working with projectVersion state incrementing on save. isDirty state tracked - Save button shows asterisk when dirty. Generate Voice and Export buttons removed from toolbar. Existing clips may have corrupted audio (multi-clip-1, multi-clip-2) which causes console warnings during playback.
